title: End-of-day POS cash-up
summary: Check a terminal's day against the sales book: enter what the book says and hear the difference, with a record kept.
description: Run it at closing time, from the web app or by chat, for each terminal: give the terminal (its name or serial number) and the total in that counter's sales book, and Taskiem adds up what the terminal took today from your POS sales table (kept by the 'Record every Moniepoint POS sale' workflow), tells you and the owner the difference and what to look for, and keeps the check in your cash-ups table so the accountant has every day's figures. Amounts are in naira.

params.title: POS sales table
params.description: The table the recording workflow writes to.

params.name: terminals_table
params.title: Terminals table
params.description: Your terminals and the names you call them.

params.title: Cash-ups table
params.description: Where each day's check is kept. Taskiem makes it for you.

definition.name: POS cash-up

Compare the terminal's day with the sales book
Keep the check in the cash-ups table
